articles.title: Lucknow-Delhi Tejas Express becomes India's first privately branded train, to be called 'Sprite' Tejas
articles.description: The Lucknow-Delhi Tejas Express will be known as the Sprite Tejas Express from August 20. Coca-Cola's Sprite unit secured branding rights for the train's name and coaches. This initiative follows the railways' exploration of private participation in train operations.
